justifiedBaselineUpdates.reason: M1.1.3 (Codex-verified): <Environment preset="apartment"> fetched lebombo_1k.hdr from a remote CDN (raw.githack.com/pmndrs/drei-assets); a failed/blocked fetch rejected past Suspense into no error boundary, taking down the whole /builder route with Next.js's fatal page-load error. Fix removes the remote dependency at its root: swaps the drei Environment import/element for a new local, procedurally-generated environment (src/components/builder/LocalEnvironment.jsx, using three's bundled RoomEnvironment + PMREMGenerator, zero network calls) wrapped in a new defensive error boundary (src/components/builder/SceneEnhancementBoundary.jsx). No layout, panel, camera, base lighting, or existing behavior changed.
justifiedBaselineUpdates.diffSummary: +5/-2 lines: Environment import replaced by LocalEnvironment + SceneEnhancementBoundary imports; <Environment preset="apartment" /> replaced by <SceneEnhancementBoundary><LocalEnvironment /></SceneEnhancementBoundary>.
